templates.question_template: 列出{date}物量态势中的工序
templates.standard_sql: SELECT PROCESS FROM dwr_mps_ttyear_wide WHERE RECORDDATE='2025-07-10' AND TARTYPE='物量态势' ORDER BY PROCESS ASC
